TRAVEL POLICY

General Guidelines

Koenig will do the flight bookings (employees should not book on their own). Kites will have access to their unutilized Frequent flyer points (if any) by Travel Desk.

  • Hopefully this will give Peace of Mind to future Koenig Travelers.
  • Travel desk will be booking your stay as per the company guidelines.
  • It is mandatory for trainers to utilize Metro/Tube systems in cities like Dubai, London, Singapore, and Australia, whenever possible for their commuting needs.
  • All travel-related approvals by payrolls.
  • Koenig will provide medical insurance for international travel.
  • Koenig follows a policy of double occupancy (twin beds).
  • Single-room accommodation will be provided in case of ILO batches only
  • Telephonic calls while traveling will not be borne by Koenig.
  • No separate claims for meals or miscellaneous expenses (such as snacks, laundry, water, sim, travel adapters and tips,etc.) will be entertained as they are part of DA.
  • Laundry expenses are not reimbursed.
  • In case of no show (for any reason), total flight cost would be borne by the employee.
  • Return Flight (Male Trainers): Return tickets for male trainers will be booked for the same day or as next day as per the availability /Travel policy, allowing ample spare time to reach the airport as per the flight schedule.
  • Return Flight (Female Trainers): Female trainers' return flights will be scheduled for the day after the batch concludes.
  • Travelers to manage the frequent flier points and can use them for personal travel

If the trainer wishes to travel by their own conveyance, reimbursement will be as per KM charges. (Two wheeler- INR 3/KM and 4 wheeler- INR 8/KM)
  • It is the responsibility of Kite to ensure that their passport and vaccination records are valid and updated in the RMS - Employee Self Service Panel.
  • Trainers must carry their passports (old and new) when traveling for any domestic or international batch, as batches can be assigned at any time and location.
  • Yellow Fever and Polio vaccination certificates must also be carried during the travel.
  • Ensure to carry a government ID proof during travel, such as the Aadhar card and Emirate ID (UAE resident visa holders)
  • No DA, No taxi for travel within Delhi-NCR.

DA for Travel day as per base Country of traveler

DA paid for travel days as per following:

  1. Travel Day = day of the flight if scheduled departure is before 5:00 PM or arrival is after 12pm to the base location.
  2. Delays not be considered this.
  3. For stays longer than 30 days, TA/DA will be settled monthly.
  4. Not applicable for long term stay. Long term = 30 days or more
  5. Not applicable for OBs
  6. DA and travel reimbursement are not applicable on leave days.


Example – You have a 5 days batch starting from 31st Aug (Monday) in USA. Your flight leaves on Saturday (29th Aug) at 8 PM. You return back at 7:00 AM on 6th Sep (Sunday). You will get DA for 30th, 31st, 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th

Conveyance will be paid on actual.

Update ESS:

Please note, while booking travel for your batches many discrepancies are found in origin city.

Kindly update your “Preferred City of Work” and “Nearest City” on your ESS and update accordingly so that travel bookings are done properly. Also it is mandatory for all trainers to keep their ESS updated with all the information for e.g previous employment, eductaion, passport, Adhaar card etc.

Claiming of Travel Insurance from ICICI Lombard Travel insurance:

Employee (except residence visa holder travelling to Dubai) will be getting travel insurance from company ,In case of claim which is directly by insurance company below procedure can be followed (ICICI Lambord insurance process)

  1. Read Travel insurance for various claims which are eligible in travel insurance
  2. In case of checked in Baggage Delay from airlines (not in home country), If baggage delayed report a PIR(property Irregularity report) to baggage missing counter and take copy of PIR from them
  3. If checked in Baggage Delay from airlines for more then 6 hours emergency items like Cloths/Toiletries for maximum of USD 100 can be purchased if needed but must be with receipt.
  4. When baggage comes back mandatory to take a delivery of baggage receipt from airlines with proof of time and date on it.
  5. Raise claim initimation to insurance company about delay in baggage
  6. In case of complete lost all of above plus baggage untraced report from airlines
  7. Only you can claim from airlines or Insurance company in case you taken airlines coupon or money insurance company will not provide any claim on it.

Claims Procedure:

In the event of an accident or sudden illness or any other claim (cashless or reimbursement) caused by a contingency covered

under the insurance policy, immediately contact the helpline number stating the necessary details.

Contact the ICICI Lombard 24hr Help Line number for assistance and registering your claim:

From USA and Canada: +18448711200 (Toll Free)

From Rest of the World: +91 124 4498778 (Call back facility)

In India: 1800 102 5721 (Toll free and accessible in India (available from Mon-Fri between 9am- 6pm))

Fax: + 91 124 4006674

E-mail: icicilombard@falck.com

Website :www.falck.com

Yellow Fever & Polio Vaccination:

Please be informed about the change in Yellow Fever and Polio Vaccination.

  • A trainer with permission of their manager can go for Yellow Fever Vaccination during office hours – no deduction will be made.
  • Travel Expense will be borne by the company only if vaccination is not in the town.
  • Cost of Vaccination will be borne by the company.
  • The reimbursement of the vaccination cost will be capped at maximum to INR 5,000.
  • Any Reimbursement request over and the above amount needs to be prior approved by the Travel Desk. 
  • Travel reimbursement will be capped at INR 1,000 both the ways.
  • Employees are encouraging to use Public Transport for the Vaccination

Base Location

Based on the growth of our company's business model and the demands of classroom training (ILT) requirements we would like to clarify a few norms for change of your base location. To change your base location, please note the following conditions:

(1) Must not change the base location in less than 6 months.

(2) Must submit a separate request to HR with approval from your reporting manager.

We encourage open communication and discussion with your manager regarding feasibility and potential impacts. Please adhere to the established procedures for base location changes.

Exam Sponsorship

  1. Cost Recovery
    • Exam Cost:
      • The cost for the first attempt is reimbursed, regardless of the result, provided the trainer delivers at least one assignment related to the certification.
      • If the assignment is not delivered, the exam cost is recoverable (even if passed) and will be deducted during F&F.
      • For second attempts, costs are not reimbursed. Any available discounts will be passed on to the trainer.
    • Courseware:
      • If any courseware is issued, the cost will be recovered from the specific trainer, even if used by the team.
      • If the trainer delivers a related assignment, the courseware cost will be waived.
  2. OEM Certification Renewals
    • If renewed via exam: Trainer must deliver at least two related assignment post-renewal.
    • If renewed by paying a fee only (no exam): Trainer must deliver at least 10 related batches for the cost to be waived.
    • If above conditions are not met, the cost is recoverable.

Overseas Trainer Policy

Policy on Visa Process and Commitment:

 

  1. Moving forward, no separate (stamp paper) commitment will be required for visa processing. Once a trainer agrees to commitment for visas, an entry will be made in the RMS, and a confirmation email will be sent outlining the terms and conditions to the trainer.

 

  1. The commitment made by the trainer will be valid for one year from the date of entry in RMS, regardless of when the visa is applied. In case of visa rejection or non-application of visa within reasonable time, the commitment will be null and void.

 

  1. If the trainer leaves within 1 year from the date of commitment, INR 1 lac will be recovered.

 

This policy reinforces Koenig's for simplification and transparency. It is designed to protect the interest of the Kites and the Kompany.

Visa commitment policy is a critical component of Koenig’s strategy for leadership in ILT and FMAT.

We request all trainers to adhere to this policy to ensure a smooth and transparent visa application process. This policy is effective immediately.

 

FAQ:

 

1. When does the one-year commitment period start?
A. The commitment period starts from the date of entry in the RMS, regardless of when the visa is applied for.

 

2. What happens if my visa is rejected?
A. If the visa is rejected, the commitment becomes null and void unless another visa is also applied for during the same commitment period.

 

3. Will I be charged if I leave within 1 year, but the visa hasn’t been received yet?
A. No. Travel will make arrangements to apply for visa as soon as entry is made in RMS. In case of any inordinate delay, travel desk will cancel the visa commitment with you.
